ops.title: Operations
support.title: Customer requests
landing.h1: Get your pending payments in, without the awkward phone calls.
landing.lede: Record an invoice once. Vasool then follows up politely on WhatsApp and SMS on a schedule you set, takes the payment through your own gateway, and hands you an evidence pack for the late ones. Every message is generated in English or Hindi and you can see and edit it before it goes.
landing.trial_note: 14 days free. No card needed. Cancel with one click.
landing.f1_title: A follow-up ladder, not one reminder
landing.f1_body: Nine touches over four months, from a friendly nudge three days before the due date to a formal MSMED-aware letter. Polite by default, firmer only as time passes.
landing.f2_body: Connect Razorpay or Cashfree and customer payments settle straight into your account. We never touch your money and never see card details.
landing.f3_body: Your customer can say 'already paid', 'this amount is wrong', or 'can I pay in three parts?'. When they do, the reminders stop and you get told.
landing.how1_body: Customer, amount, due date. GST is split into CGST/SGST or IGST for you, and the invoice carries the buyer's GSTIN and place of supply.
landing.how2_body: You see the exact Hindi or English text that will be sent, on which date. Nothing goes out that you have not seen.
landing.how3_body: They pay on a secure gateway page. The moment it is confirmed server-side, reminders stop and the invoice is marked paid.
landing.preview_title: This is what your customer receives
landing.preview_body: Real example, in English. The Hindi version is written by a person, not machine-translated.
landing.preview_note: Every reminder is a normal transactional message about a real invoice. No marketing, no upsell, nothing that makes you look bad.
landing.trust_title: What we do with your data
landing.trust1: We collect the minimum: your business details, your customers' contact details, and the invoice amounts.
landing.trust2: We do not ask for or store Aadhaar or your customers' PAN, and card numbers never reach us.
landing.trust3: We message only customers who have opted in, and we stop the moment consent is withdrawn.
landing.trust4: You can export or delete a customer's data from the app, and security logs are retained for 180 days as Indian rules require.
landing.honest_title: Who this is not for yet
landing.honest_body: No testimonials or customer counts here, because we are new and we will not invent them.
landing.honest_placeholder: This space is reserved for real reviews from real businesses once we have them. Until then, judge us on the free trial.
pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.lede: Priced for Indian businesses, in rupees. GST extra where applicable.
pricing.q1: Do you take a cut of the payments my customers make?
pricing.a1: No. Your customers pay through your own gateway, and that money goes straight to you. You pay your gateway its usual fee and pay us a flat subscription.
pricing.a2: Reminders pause and your data stays put. Nothing is deleted for 90 days, and you can export everything at any time.
pricing.a3: Yes, and by card or netbanking, through the payment gateway's checkout. We do not store your card details.
checkout.redirecting: Taking you to the secure payment page
checkout.note: You will enter your payment details on the gateway's own page, not here.
checkout.problem: Payment is being confirmed. This page shows the real status — refresh in a moment.
sandbox.title: Sandbox checkout
sandbox.note: This is a stand-in for the payment gateway's page, used only when no live gateway is configured. No real money moves.
